verdict.rationale: No evidence of a dedicated sandbox/staging environment isolated from production data; the closest hints are a serverless free-credit test account (together-ai-comm-3) and prototyping-then-scaling guidance (together-ai-docs-26), neither of which describes an actual sandbox that isolates test activity from production data. missing for 10: dedicated sandbox/staging mode, test API keys separate from production, documentation of data isolation guarantees.
